<reason>PRO kept a live leverage route CON never neutralized: captive renewal pricing and gatekept integration require credible exit. CON's fallback to award-stage competition and whole-stack rebid concedes leverage matters but needs portability to be credible, making the rebid a bluff. CON's safety and poor-district pressures were real but answered enough by staged swaps and conformance testing to leave PRO's comparison cleaner.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A's closing turn of B's rebid defense into a concession: if retraining makes portability a bluff, whole-stack rebid is a bigger bluff, and a rebid without portability is renegotiating with a monopolist.</best_rebuttal>
